purpose: Define the deliberately loosened evidence tier for investor-scale case recall without misrepresenting answer-safe proposition accuracy.
allowed_claim: Up to 10,000 Hong Kong criminal judgments can be indexed for citation/source-page accurate recall after each card validates against a public LegalRef/HKLII/Judiciary source.
forbidden_claims: HKLII paragraph-anchored propositions unless paragraph anchors are separately extracted and validated
minimum_case_recall_card_requirements: public source provider is LegalRef, HKLII, or Judiciary
LegalRef DIS or equivalent public source id is stored
neutral citation is parsed and validates against Hong Kong neutral citation format
case name is parsed from the public judgment page
separation_rules: case_recall_only vectors go into QDRANT_COLLECTION_CASE_RECALL, not the proposition collection
case_recall_only cards may support search, lookup, and citation discovery
case_recall_only cards must not be used as source-gated legal claims unless promoted through paragraph/proposition extraction
answer demos must continue to use answer_safe or clearly machine_candidate proposition cards
